anandpur-sahib.name: Anandpur Sahib
anandpur-sahib.tagline: Virasat-e-Khalsa museum alone is worth the trip — architecture that rivals the Guggenheim, telling the story of Sikh heritage.

patiala.name: Patiala
patiala.tagline: The Patiala peg, the Patiala salwar, and a palace with 15 dining halls — Punjab royalty that most tourists skip.

damdama-sahib.name: Takht Sri Damdama Sahib
damdama-sahib.tagline: One of only 5 Sikh Takhts — where Guru Gobind Singh compiled the final Guru Granth Sahib in 1706.

ajmer.name: Ajmer
ajmer.tagline: One of India most important Sufi shrines — and the gateway everyone rushes through to reach Pushkar.

alwar.name: Alwar
alwar.tagline: Bhangarh ghost fort, Sariska tiger reserve, and a city palace that rivals Jaipur — all in India most ignored Rajasthan district.

barmer.name: Barmer
barmer.tagline: The Rajasthan even Rajasthanis skip — hand-block printing villages, desert sand dunes without the Jaisalmer tourist machinery.

bharatpur.name: Bharatpur
bharatpur.tagline: Keoladeo Ghana UNESCO bird sanctuary — 350+ species including Siberian cranes, 55km from the Taj.

bikaner.name: Bikaner
bikaner.tagline: Junagarh Fort that was never conquered, a temple full of rats, and a government camel research farm — Bikaner does not do normal.

bundi.name: Bundi
bundi.tagline: The Rajasthan that tourism forgot — 50 stepwells, a crumbling fort, painted havelis, and zero selfie sticks.

chittorgarh.name: Chittorgarh
chittorgarh.tagline: India's largest fort — 700 acres of Rajput defiance, Padmini's palace, and the Tower of Victory.

deeg.name: Deeg
deeg.tagline: A water palace where 900 fountains once fired simultaneously — Rajasthan's most underrated monsoon palace.

dungarpur.name: Dungarpur
dungarpur.tagline: The palace town south of Udaipur that even palace enthusiasts don't know about.

gagron-fort.name: Gagron Fort
gagron-fort.tagline: India's only hill-and-water fort — UNESCO World Heritage

jaipur.name: Jaipur
jaipur.tagline: Every fort in Jaipur makes you feel like a Maharaja, and the city dresses in pink to make sure you notice.

jaisalmer.name: Jaisalmer
jaisalmer.tagline: The only fort in India where 3000 people still LIVE — shops, temples, hotels, inside a 12th-century citadel.

jodhpur.name: Jodhpur
jodhpur.tagline: Mehrangarh is the fort that makes every other fort in Rajasthan feel like a rehearsal.

kumbhalgarh.name: Kumbhalgarh
kumbhalgarh.tagline: The second longest wall in the world after China — hilltop fort with 360-degree Aravalli views.

mount-abu.name: Mount Abu
mount-abu.tagline: Rajasthan only hill station — and Dilwara Jain temples are the most intricate marble carvings in India.

neemrana.name: Neemrana
neemrana.tagline: A 15th century fort turned into India most famous heritage hotel — and the zip-line across its ramparts.

osian.name: Osian
osian.tagline: The Khajuraho of Rajasthan — 8th century temples in the Thar Desert that nobody visits.

pushkar.name: Pushkar
pushkar.tagline: The only Brahma temple in India, a holy lake older than recorded history, and a camel fair that defies description.

ranthambore.name: Ranthambore
ranthambore.tagline: THE tiger park. If you see one, you will talk about it for years. If you do not, the fort and the jungle are still worth it.

sariska.name: Sariska Tiger Reserve
sariska.tagline: The most accessible tiger reserve from Delhi and Jaipur

shekhawati.name: Shekhawati
shekhawati.tagline: The open-air art gallery of Rajasthan — 400-year-old painted havelis in towns nobody visits.

udaipur.name: Udaipur
udaipur.tagline: The most romantic city in India, and it knows it — every rooftop restaurant has a view of the lake and every sunset feels staged.

aritar.name: Aritar
aritar.tagline: Old Silk-Route village around Lampokhari lake and paragliding hills

dzongu.name: Dzongu
dzongu.tagline: The Lepcha tribal reserve of North Sikkim — homestays, hot springs, waterfalls

gangtok.name: Gangtok
gangtok.tagline: India's cleanest hill town — monasteries, momos, and jaw-dropping Kanchenjunga views from a state where plastic bags have been illegal since 1998.

gurudongmar-lake.name: Gurudongmar Lake
gurudongmar-lake.tagline: Sacred lake at 17,800 ft — one of highest lakes in the world, frozen Nov-May, stunning turquoise in summer.

khangchendzonga-np.name: Khangchendzonga National Park
khangchendzonga-np.tagline: India's ONLY mixed UNESCO World Heritage Site — home to the world's third-highest peak at 8,586m. Sacred to the Lepcha people.

lachen.name: Lachen
lachen.tagline: North Sikkim base for Gurudongmar and Chopta Valley, Lachungpa tribal village.

lachung.name: Lachung
lachung.tagline: Gateway to Yumthang Valley and Zero Point — rhododendron paradise in North Sikkim.

mangan.name: Mangan
mangan.tagline: The gateway town to North Sikkim — Lachen, Lachung and Gurudongmar start here

namchi.name: Namchi
namchi.tagline: Giant Guru Padmasambhava statue, Char Dham replica, and South Sikkim's laid-back capital.

nathu-la.name: Nathu La
nathu-la.tagline: A 4,310 m India–China border pass on the old Silk Route

pelling.name: Pelling
pelling.tagline: Front-row seats to Kanchenjunga — a tiny ridge town with the 17th-century Pemayangtse monastery and the new Chenrezig statue that dwarfs everything.

phodong.name: Phodong
phodong.tagline: An 18th-century Nyingma monastery on the road north to Mangan

ravangla.name: Ravangla
ravangla.tagline: Buddha Park with 130-foot statue, Temi Tea Garden, and the best Kanchenjunga panorama in South Sikkim.

rinchenpong.name: Rinchenpong
rinchenpong.tagline: A quiet West-Sikkim ridge with full Kanchenjunga views and old monasteries

tashiding.name: Tashiding
tashiding.tagline: Sikkim's holiest Nyingma monastery and the Bhumchu sacred-water festival

tsomgo-lake.name: Tsomgo Lake
tsomgo-lake.tagline: Sacred glacial lake at 12,313 ft, 40 km from Gangtok, gateway to Nathula Pass (India-China border).

yuksom.name: Yuksom
yuksom.tagline: First capital of Sikkim and base camp for Goechala trek to Kanchenjunga. Coronation throne of first Chogyal.

yumthang-valley.name: Yumthang Valley
yumthang-valley.tagline: Sikkim's Valley of Flowers — rhododendrons carpet the meadow, Feb–June

zuluk.name: Zuluk
zuluk.tagline: The Silk Route's 32 hairpin bends — where the road itself is the destination and Kanchenjunga fills the horizon.

anamalai.name: Anamalai Tiger Reserve (Topslip)
anamalai.tagline: Topslip — lion-tailed macaques, bamboo rafting, and the Anamalai Hills

chennai.name: Chennai
chennai.tagline: Marina Beach, Fort St. George, Carnatic music — South India's cultural capital

chettinad.name: Chettinad
chettinad.tagline: India's spiciest cuisine and 10,000 palatial mansions with Burma teak and Italian marble

chidambaram.name: Chidambaram
chidambaram.tagline: Nataraja Temple — Shiva as Cosmic Dancer, the Pancha Bhuta Stala of Space

coimbatore.name: Coimbatore
coimbatore.tagline: Adiyogi statue (112ft Guinness record) and the gateway to the Nilgiris

coonoor.name: Coonoor
coonoor.tagline: Nilgiri tea capital — quieter than Ooty, on the UNESCO toy train route

courtallam.name: Courtallam (Kutralam)
courtallam.tagline: Spa of South India — 9 herb-infused waterfalls with natural healing properties

dhanushkodi.name: Dhanushkodi
dhanushkodi.tagline: India's only ghost town — 1964 cyclone ruins at the absolute tip of India

hogenakkal.name: Hogenakkal Falls
hogenakkal.tagline: India's Niagara — coracle rides through waterfalls and a 2,000-year-old oil massage tradition

kanchipuram.name: Kanchipuram
kanchipuram.tagline: City of 1,000 Temples — sacred for both Shaivites and Vaishnavites, and home to India's finest silk

kanyakumari.name: Kanyakumari
kanyakumari.tagline: India's southernmost tip — the only place where you watch sunrise AND sunset over the sea

kodaikanal.name: Kodaikanal
kodaikanal.tagline: Princess of Hill Stations — star-shaped lake, Coaker's Walk cliff promenade, and the 12-year Kurinji bloom

kotagiri.name: Kotagiri
kotagiri.tagline: The OLDEST Nilgiri hill station — Ooty without the crowds

kumbakonam.name: Kumbakonam
kumbakonam.tagline: Temple City — 188 temples, Airavatesvara (UNESCO), and the Mahamaham tank

madurai.name: Madurai
madurai.tagline: The Lotus City — Meenakshi Temple with 33,000 sculptures and a midnight closing ritual

mahabalipuram.name: Mahabalipuram (Mamallapuram)
mahabalipuram.tagline: UNESCO Pallava rock-cut temples on the Coromandel Coast — beach + heritage in one

meghamalai.name: Meghamalai (High Wavy Mountains)
meghamalai.tagline: Cloud forest with zero tourism — advance estate booking required

mudumalai.name: Mudumalai National Park
mudumalai.tagline: Nilgiri Biosphere — elephant safaris where Karnataka, Kerala, and Tamil Nadu meet

ooty.name: Ooty (Udagamandalam)
ooty.tagline: Queen of the Nilgiris — tea estates, toy train (UNESCO), and Doddabetta Peak

palani.name: Palani
palani.tagline: Sacred hilltop where Murugan meditated as an ascetic

pazhamudircholai.name: Pazhamudircholai
pazhamudircholai.tagline: Murugan's shrine with both consorts Deivanai and Valli

point-calimere.name: Point Calimere Wildlife Sanctuary
point-calimere.tagline: 30,000 flamingos, blackbuck antelope, and Ramsar Wetland where the coast turns

rameswaram.name: Rameswaram
rameswaram.tagline: India's Varanasi of the South — Char Dham, longest temple corridor, and Pamban Bridge

srirangam.name: Srirangam
srirangam.tagline: The LARGEST functioning Hindu temple in the world — 156 acres, 7 walls, 21 gopurams

swamimalai.name: Swamimalai
swamimalai.tagline: Where Murugan taught the Om mantra to his father Shiva

thanjavur.name: Thanjavur (Tanjore)
thanjavur.tagline: Brihadeeswara Temple — the UNESCO Chola masterpiece whose vimana casts no shadow at noon

tharangambadi.name: Tharangambadi (Tranquebar)
tharangambadi.tagline: India's only Danish colonial town — Fort Dansborg (1620) and India's oldest Protestant church

tiruchendur.name: Tiruchendur
tiruchendur.tagline: Murugan's coastal shrine where he vanquished the demon Surapadman

tiruparankundram.name: Tiruparankundram
tiruparankundram.tagline: Murugan's hilltop temple where he married Deivanai

tiruttani.name: Tiruttani
tiruttani.tagline: Hilltop temple where Murugan regained inner peace

tiruvannamalai.name: Tiruvannamalai
tiruvannamalai.tagline: Arunachala — the fire-element Pancha Bhoota Stalam

trichy.name: Trichy (Tiruchirappalli)
trichy.tagline: Rock Fort Temple on an 83m rock — one of India's most dramatic urban temple settings

valparai.name: Valparai
valparai.tagline: 40 hairpin bends to an untouched hill station — lion-tailed macaques and cloud forests

vedanthangal.name: Vedanthangal Bird Sanctuary
vedanthangal.tagline: India's oldest bird sanctuary (1798) — 40,000 nesting waterbirds, 75km from Chennai

yercaud.name: Yercaud
yercaud.tagline: Poor Man's Ooty — Eastern Ghats hill station with coffee, oranges, and zero pretension

adilabad.name: Adilabad
adilabad.tagline: Kuntala Falls, tiger reserve, and Gond tribal culture — Telangana's wild north

alampur.name: Alampur
alampur.tagline: Navabrahma — nine 7th-century Shiva temples where two rivers meet

ananthagiri-hills.name: Ananthagiri Hills
ananthagiri-hills.tagline: Hyderabad's nearest hill escape — 79km to misty forests and ancient temples

basara.name: Basara
basara.tagline: One of only two Saraswathi temples in India — where children begin their education

bhadrachalam.name: Bhadrachalam
bhadrachalam.tagline: Rama Temple on the Godavari — 100,000 pilgrims flood in on Vaikuntha Ekadasi

bhongir.name: Bhongir
bhongir.tagline: Egg-shaped monolithic fort — a 10th-century geological freak you can climb

hyderabad.name: Hyderabad
hyderabad.tagline: Biryani capital of India — Charminar, Golconda, and 400 years of Nizam grandeur

kolanupaka.name: Kolanupaka
kolanupaka.tagline: 2,000-year-old jade Mahaveer statue — Telangana's hidden Jain treasure

laknavaram.name: Laknavaram
laknavaram.tagline: 13 forested islands connected by a 160m suspension bridge — Kakatiya-era engineering

medak.name: Medak
medak.tagline: One of Asia's largest churches + a 12th-century fort — Deccan's hidden heritage

nagarjuna-konda.name: Nagarjuna Konda
nagarjuna-konda.tagline: Buddhist island museum — 30 monasteries submerged, treasures preserved on a hilltop

pillalamarri.name: Pillalamarri
pillalamarri.tagline: 800-year-old banyan tree — India's 2nd largest, with Sufi tombs underneath

pochampally.name: Pochampally
pochampally.tagline: UNESCO-recognized ikat weaving village — India's first GI-tagged handloom

ramappa-temple.name: Ramappa Temple
ramappa-temple.tagline: UNESCO World Heritage (2021) — the only temple in India named after its sculptor

warangal.name: Warangal
warangal.tagline: Kakatiya capital — the gateway that became Telangana's state emblem

agartala.name: Agartala
agartala.tagline: Ujjayanta Palace, Neermahal water palace, and India's most underrated state capital on the Bangladesh border.

jampui-hills.name: Jampui Hills
jampui-hills.tagline: Eternal Hills of Spring, Betlingchhip peak at 3,080 ft, year-round trekking

neermahal.name: Neermahal
neermahal.tagline: India's largest water palace — built in 1930 in the middle of Rudrasagar Lake, Mughal-Hindu hybrid architecture, boat access only

unakoti.name: Unakoti
unakoti.tagline: 7th-8th century rock carvings in a forested hillside — giant Shiva heads (30 ft), Ganga in stone, 10 million figures of legend. India's most underrated archaeological site

agra.name: Agra
agra.tagline: The Taj Mahal is worth every cliche ever written about it — and Mehtab Bagh at sunset, when the crowds thin, is when it stops being a monument and starts being magic.

ayodhya.name: Ayodhya
ayodhya.tagline: The newly built Ram Mandir has turned a 500-year-old dispute into India biggest pilgrimage boom.

chitrakoot.name: Chitrakoot
chitrakoot.tagline: Where Ram spent 11 of his 14 years of exile — the most important Ramayana site outside Ayodhya.

dudhwa-national-park.name: Dudhwa National Park
dudhwa-national-park.tagline: UP only national park — tigers, rhinos, and swamp deer in a terai wilderness that nobody from outside UP visits.

fatehpur-sikri.name: Fatehpur Sikri
fatehpur-sikri.tagline: Akbar built an entire capital city in 1571, used it for 14 years, then abandoned it forever — the red sandstone ghost city still stands untouched.

kushinagar.name: Kushinagar
kushinagar.tagline: Where the Buddha died — one of the four holiest Buddhist sites on Earth and India most undervisited pilgrimage.

lucknow.name: Lucknow
lucknow.tagline: The city where food is religion, manners are art, and the Bara Imambara is the most underrated monument in India.

mathura.name: Mathura
mathura.tagline: Krishna's birthplace — the jail cell temple, Vishram Ghat on the Yamuna, and India's most colorful Holi.

prayagraj.name: Prayagraj
prayagraj.tagline: Where three rivers meet and 100 million people gather every 12 years — the Triveni Sangam defies every concept of scale.

sarnath.name: Sarnath
sarnath.tagline: Where Buddha gave his first sermon — the Dhamek Stupa has stood here for 2,500 years, and this quiet park is the antidote to Varanasi's chaos.

sravasti.name: Sravasti
sravasti.tagline: Where Buddha spent 24 rainy seasons — the place he lived longest, and most Buddhists skip it for Bodh Gaya.

varanasi.name: Varanasi
varanasi.tagline: The oldest continuously inhabited city in the world, where life and death happen simultaneously on the same riverbank and neither apologizes for the other.

vrindavan.name: Vrindavan
vrindavan.tagline: City of 5000 temples — where Krishna grew up, Holi is a war, and spiritual energy is tangible.

adi-kailash.name: Adi Kailash
adi-kailash.tagline: India's answer to Mount Kailash, accessible via a 6-day trek.

almora.name: Almora
almora.tagline: The Kumaoni heritage town where Kasar Devi cosmic energy attracted Swami Vivekananda, D.H. Lawrence, and Timothy Leary before Instagram discovered it.

auli.name: Auli
auli.tagline: India's best (and basically only real) ski slope, with a front-row view of Nanda Devi.

badrinath.name: Badrinath
badrinath.tagline: One of the four Char Dham — a 1,200-year-old Vishnu temple at 3,133m that closes for six months because even the gods leave for winter.

bhimtal.name: Bhimtal
bhimtal.tagline: The quiet cousin who got the better genes — Bhimtal lake without the Nainital crowds, an island in the middle, and actual birdsong.

binsar.name: Binsar
binsar.tagline: 300km Himalayan panorama from inside an oak forest sanctuary — and nobody around.

chakrata.name: Chakrata
chakrata.tagline: A cantonment town the army forgot to tell tourists about — Tiger Falls, Deoban's ancient forests, and zero commercial tourism.

champawat.name: Champawat
champawat.tagline: Where the Chand dynasty ruled Kumaon for 800 years — temples, fort ruins, and zero tourists.

chaukori.name: Chaukori
chaukori.tagline: Tea gardens at 2010m with Panchachuli peaks as backdrop — the view Kausani gets credit for, but Chaukori does better.

chopta.name: Chopta
chopta.tagline: Mini Switzerland of Uttarakhand — rhododendron meadows, Himalayan views, and the easiest gateway to a 4000m summit.

devprayag.name: Devprayag
devprayag.tagline: The Alaknanda and Bhagirathi become the Ganges here—the holiest of the five confluences.

dhanaulti.name: Dhanaulti
dhanaulti.tagline: The quiet alternative to Mussoorie — 24km further, 90% fewer tourists.

gangotri.name: Gangotri
gangotri.tagline: The origin of the Ganges — a temple at 3,100m where Goddess Ganga descended to Earth, surrounded by deodar forests and Himalayan peaks.

gopeshwar.name: Gopeshwar
gopeshwar.tagline: Ancient Shiva temple + gateway to Chopta-Tungnath + the town where the Chipko movement began.

guptkashi.name: Guptkashi
guptkashi.tagline: The last comfortable town before Kedarnath — where smart pilgrims base themselves instead of suffering at 3583m.

har-ki-doon.name: Har Ki Doon
har-ki-doon.tagline: Cradle-shaped valley trek in the Govind sanctuary — the classic Garhwal walk.

haridwar.name: Haridwar
haridwar.tagline: Where the Ganges leaves the mountains and enters the plains — evening Ganga Aarti at Har Ki Pauri is India's most electric spiritual spectacle.

hemkund-sahib.name: Hemkund Sahib
hemkund-sahib.tagline: Sikh pilgrimage shrine at 4,633m — a 6km walk up from Ghangaria, beside a glacial lake.

corbett-national-park.name: Jim Corbett National Park
corbett-national-park.tagline: India oldest national park and the best place to see a wild tiger without Rajasthan crowds.

joshimath.name: Joshimath
joshimath.tagline: One of Shankaracharya four mathas — and the town that is literally sinking since 2023.

kanatal.name: Kanatal
kanatal.tagline: North India glamping capital — apple orchards, stargazing, zero cell signal.

karnaprayag.name: Karnaprayag
karnaprayag.tagline: The Alaknanda and Pindar rivers converge at this third prayag, honoring the Mahabharata hero Karna.

kausani.name: Kausani
kausani.tagline: 300km of Himalayan panorama from your hotel balcony — if the clouds cooperate.

kedarnath.name: Kedarnath
kedarnath.tagline: One of the 12 Jyotirlingas, sitting at 3583m beneath a glacier — open only 6 months a year.

landour.name: Landour
landour.tagline: The secret garden above Mussoorie that Ruskin Bond will never leave — Char Dukan, Lal Tibba, and walks with no one on them.

lansdowne.name: Lansdowne
lansdowne.tagline: Army cantonment frozen in time — silent oak forests, no commercial circus.

mansarovar-kailash.name: Mount Kailash & Mansarovar
mansarovar-kailash.tagline: The real Mount Kailash (6,638m) and sacred Lake Mansarovar, a 24-day yatra via the Lipulekh Pass.

mukteshwar.name: Mukteshwar
mukteshwar.tagline: Kumaon ridge village with 180-degree Himalayan views and silence that makes you question city life.

munsiyari.name: Munsiyari
munsiyari.tagline: Direct front-row seat to the Panchachuli range — Kumaon's most spectacular viewpoint that almost nobody goes to.

mussoorie.name: Mussoorie
mussoorie.tagline: The Queen of Hills — Mall Road, Kempty Falls, cloud walks, and the gateway hill station that every Indian family visits first.

nainital.name: Nainital
nainital.tagline: The lake town that India grew up with — boating, cable cars, Mall Road, and the Naini Devi temple that gives it its name.

nandaprayag.name: Nandaprayag
nandaprayag.tagline: The Alaknanda meets the Nandakini at this second sacred confluence, set in Chamoli district.

pithoragarh.name: Pithoragarh
pithoragarh.tagline: Gateway to Panchachuli peaks and Nepal border — where Kumaon gets real.

ranikhet.name: Ranikhet
ranikhet.tagline: An army cantonment town where the British came to escape the heat — pine forests, golf course at 1,800m, and Himalayan views without a single tout.

rishikesh.name: Rishikesh
rishikesh.tagline: Where yoga ashrams meet white-water rapids and the Beatles met their guru.

roopkund.name: Roopkund
roopkund.tagline: The Skeleton Lake — a glacial lake at 5,029m where hundreds of ancient human skeletons surface every summer. India's most haunting trek.

rudraprayag.name: Rudraprayag
rudraprayag.tagline: Where the Alaknanda and Mandakini unite at this fourth prayag, known as Shiva's meeting place.

tehri.name: Tehri Lake
tehri.tagline: Asia largest dam created India largest man-made lake — and now it is becoming a water sports hub.

tungnath.name: Tungnath
tungnath.tagline: The highest Shiva temple in the world at 3,680m — a 3.5km trek through rhododendron forests with Chandrashila peak summit as the reward.

uttarkashi.name: Uttarkashi
uttarkashi.tagline: The Kashi of the North — a riverside temple town that doubles as basecamp for serious Himalayan mountaineering and the Char Dham circuit.

valley-of-flowers.name: Valley of Flowers
valley-of-flowers.tagline: A UNESCO valley that blooms with 500+ wildflower species for exactly 8 weeks a year. Miss the window, miss the point.

vishnuprayag.name: Vishnuprayag
vishnuprayag.tagline: Where the Alaknanda and Dhauliganga meet: the first of five sacred confluences.

yamunotri.name: Yamunotri
yamunotri.tagline: The least visited Char Dham — a 6km trek to the source of the Yamuna with hot springs where pilgrims cook rice in muslin cloth.

darjeeling.name: Darjeeling
darjeeling.tagline: The Queen of Hills — toy train, tea gardens, and Kanchenjunga sunrise. Colonial-era charm meets Tibetan-Nepali street culture.

kolkata.name: Kolkata
kolkata.tagline: India's cultural capital — where the trams still run, the Puja pandals rewrite themselves every October, and College Street's coffee-house conversations haven't ended since 1940.

siliguri.name: Siliguri
siliguri.tagline: Chicken Neck gateway to the Northeast
